question: What claim is made about the state of one freed from all illness in relation to union with yogis?
premises: One is freed from all illness.
That one is in relation to yogis.
Union together with yogis is in view.
inference: One freed from all illness attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the union is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Freed from all illness, one attains union together with yogis.
